correctness.rationale: Over the cyclic étale cover, the center of the ambient smooth fivefold has equations the cubic-plus-square cusp polynomial and the zero normal parameter. The two ordinary blow-up charts are the first blow-up chart with the corresponding cubic-plus-square-minus-product map, and the second blow-up chart with the corresponding cubic-plus-square-minus-coordinate map. Their relative Jacobian ideals are the ideal generated by the squared cubic variable and the remaining three transverse variables and (1), respectively. All other center points are relative-smooth, hence the blow-up is smooth there. A general sextic has six simple zeros. Because the cyclic action is free on the elliptic A, quotient descent is étale: the generator sends the elliptic point and nilpotent coordinate to translation of the elliptic point and weight-two scaling of the nilpotent, so the nilradical is the associated order-3 eigensheaf M on the elliptic quotient. the third tensor power of the nilpotent line bundle is trivial, and M is nontrivial because a nontrivial equivariant eigenfunction on the complete connected A would be a nonconstant regular function. Elliptic Serre duality yields its zero-th and first cohomology vanish. The checked path verify.py executed successfully and verified the exact local Jacobian ideal and character arithmetic. It does not claim to verify global descent by finite computation.

originality.rationale: The original full text arXiv:2608.10973v1 establishes the fivefold, six singular fibers, dimension-one critical support and pointwise analytic normal form (Theorem 1, Example 23, Eq. (13), Remark 24). It does not state the full scheme, splitting, torsion order, or coherent-cohomology invariance. Those require retaining the global cyclic character through the blow-up and descending along the degree-six elliptic isogeny, which cannot be recovered from the local analytic isomorphism type. Related 2026 rational-elliptic-surface classification does not study the fivefold quotient-blowup. Searches in published-finding corpus and primary-literature indexes did not find a stronger covering statement, although this is not a proof of global uniqueness.

value.rationale: The fibration is a key concrete example separating topological and analytic smoothness. Its complete critical scheme is a natural intrinsic invariant. The three-torsion conormal detects nontrivial global equivariant monodromy invisible in the published pointwise normal forms and shows that reduction changes nilpotent structure without changing any structure-sheaf cohomology in all degrees; these structural facts are not a trivial renaming of the local derivative computation. The complete six-component classification and precise cohomology comparison give future researchers canonical algebraic invariants for distinguishing topologically invisible morphisms, without requiring a downstream theorem.
